sections.title: Introducing our solutions
sections.description: The SIGMA ecosystem — purpose-built for the power and energy sector

sections.title: SIGMA.SSPTI
sections.description: SSPTI is an industrial software solution supporting the collection, consolidation, normalisation, processing, storage and transmission of technology data from multiple sources including DCS, SCADA, PLC, sensors, measurement devices and databases. The system centralises distributed data on a unified platform, providing a reliable data source for operational monitoring, analytics, reporting and integration with ERP, EAM and PAS systems.

sections.title: SIGMA.SUPA
sections.description: SUPA (Enterprise Asset Management – EAM) is an enterprise asset management system for the power and energy sector, supporting the digitalisation and management of the entire asset lifecycle on a unified platform. It integrates equipment data, technical condition, maintenance and repair records, materials and operating costs — helping organisations improve equipment reliability, standardise maintenance processes and optimise asset utilisation.

sections.title: SIGMA.PAS
sections.description: SIGMA.PAS (Predictive Analytics System) is a solution for monitoring, diagnosing and analysing equipment condition, applying advanced mathematical models combined with AI and Machine Learning. It enables early detection of anomalies, prediction of failure risks and assessment of incident probability — enhancing operational reliability and optimising maintenance planning.

sections.title: SIGMA.ALKOR
sections.description: SIGMA.ALKOR is a mobile software platform supporting the management and automation of field engineering work in the power and utilities sector. It integrates GPS positioning, connectivity with MRO/EAM/ERP and GIS systems, and supports the coordination of inspection, maintenance, repair and incident response activities.

sections.title: SIGMA.SUS
sections.description: SIGMA.SUS is a grid management system that collects, consolidates, validates and visualises data from multiple technology and operational systems on a unified platform. It standardises equipment data, verifies grid structure and data accuracy, and provides information for situational operations, maintenance, transmission, grid development planning and connection management.

detailPages.title: JSC Inter RAO – Electric Power Generation
detailPages.summary: Deploying the SIGMA ecosystem to support industrial data collection and asset management for the Inter RAO power group.

sections.title: Background
sections.description: JSC Inter RAO – Electric Power Generation operates multiple power plants with thousands of industrial assets. Data from SCADA, DCS and sensors existed in silos, with no unified platform for analysis and operational decision-making.

sections.title: Solution deployed
sections.description: SIGMA.SSPTI was deployed to collect and normalise technology data flows from all existing systems, combined with SIGMA.SUPA to build a centralised asset management system — tracking technical condition, maintenance history and equipment lifecycle in real time.

sections.title: Results
sections.description: A unified operational data source from DCS, SCADA and sensors. Maintenance shifted from reactive to proactive, minimising unplanned incidents. Management teams make decisions based on accurate, continuously updated data.

detailPages.title: LLC Bashkir Generation Company
detailPages.summary: Applying SIGMA.SUPA and SIGMA.ALKOR to optimise maintenance planning and field operations at Bashkir Generation Company.

sections.title: Background
sections.description: LLC Bashkir Generation Company is a major electricity and heat producer operating numerous generating units and equipment across a wide area. Maintenance was largely reactive, with poor connectivity between field teams and management.

sections.title: Solution deployed
sections.description: SIGMA.SUPA was deployed for centralised equipment record management and needs-based maintenance planning. SIGMA.ALKOR enabled field technicians to receive work orders, inspect equipment and record results directly on mobile devices.

sections.title: Results
sections.description: Maintenance processes became standardised and proactive. Field information is updated instantly into the management system, reducing incident response time and improving operational safety.

detailPages.title: JSC Territorial Generating Company No. 11
detailPages.summary: Integrating the SIGMA ecosystem to support full asset lifecycle management and improve operational efficiency for TGK-11.

sections.title: Background
sections.description: JSC Territorial Generating Company No. 11 (TGK-11) operates thermal power plants in Western Siberia. Its diverse asset base lacked a unified platform for managing technical data, maintenance records and materials.

sections.title: Solution deployed
sections.description: A comprehensive SIGMA ecosystem integration was undertaken — SIGMA.SSPTI for data collection, SIGMA.SUPA for asset management and SIGMA.ALKOR for field operations support — connecting technical data, maintenance, materials and operating costs across the full asset lifecycle.

sections.title: Results
sections.description: TGK-11 gained a comprehensive view of all assets on a single platform. Operational efficiency improved, maintenance costs decreased and equipment reliability increased significantly.

detailPages.title: JSC Tomsk Generation
detailPages.summary: Deploying SIGMA.ALKOR and SIGMA.SUS to enhance field operations capability and power grid visualisation at Tomsk Generation.

sections.title: Background
sections.description: JSC Tomsk Generation produces and supplies electricity and heat to the Tomsk region and surrounding areas. A distributed grid and disconnected inspection and repair data between field teams and the control centre created operational challenges.

sections.title: Solution deployed
sections.description: SIGMA.ALKOR was deployed to digitalise field operations — enabling technicians to receive tasks, inspect equipment and report results instantly. SIGMA.SUS provided a GIS platform visualising the entire grid, supporting incident response and development planning.

sections.title: Results
sections.description: Field operations were standardised and incident response times reduced significantly. Operations teams gained a real-time, comprehensive view of the grid — improving planning quality and operational performance.
